articles.title: Hegseth staff damaged historic WWII-era Eisenhower globe trying to move it to his office - NBC News
articles.description: The globe was especially notable because it had green pen or marker notations where Gen. Dwight D. Eisenhower marked areas in Europe, three U.S. officials said.
